title: Deferring Part of a Period's Recovery on a Restricted Account
content:
Where an Employee Meal Account has been running short at the till, part of what a payroll period would recover is held back into a later period instead. Two amounts are fixed for this: the deep deferral amount of $45.00 and the light deferral amount of $20.00.

**Clause.** Where the account stands restricted and two or more overdraft charges have been raised on it in the three calendar months running back from the day the account is worked, the part deferred into a later period is the deep deferral amount. Where the account stands restricted and exactly one overdraft charge has been raised on it in the three calendar months running back from the day the account is worked, the part deferred is the light deferral amount. Where neither holds, nothing is deferred.

## Schedule of deferrals

| Account state | Overdraft charges raised in the three calendar months running back from the day the account is worked | Deferred into a later period |
|---|---|---|
| Restricted | 2 or more | $45.00 |
| Restricted | Exactly 1 | $20.00 |
| Restricted | None | Nothing |
| Active, parked for leave, enrolled or closed | Any number | Nothing |

## Notes on the count

What is counted is overdraft charges raised on the account, over the three calendar months running back from the day the account is worked, and both bands are written for an account that stands restricted. An account that stands active carries no deferral however many overdraft charges it has taken, and a restricted account with a clean three months carries none either.

*Hypothetical illustration.* A restricted account carrying 3 overdraft charges over the three calendar months running back from the day the account is worked defers $45.00 of the period's recovery; the same account with a single such charge defers $20.00.
